stemMd:
A researcher claims that a treatment improves germination most strongly in dry conditions.

| Conditions | Untreated seeds germinating (%) | Treated seeds germinating (%) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Dry | 35 | 65 |
| Moderate | 70 | 80 |
| Wet | 82 | 84 |

Which comparison best supports the claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The treatment has no effect outside dry conditions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Treated seeds have their highest germination in wet conditions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Untreated seeds germinate best in dry conditions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Treatment raises germination by 30 percentage points in dry conditions, compared with 10 in moderate and 2 in wet conditions.

explanationMd: The claim concerns improvement due to treatment, so compare treated minus untreated within each condition. The dry-condition increase is much larger than the other two differences.

distractorRationale.b: That describes the level, not the treatment's additional effect.
distractorRationale.c: Their lowest value is in dry conditions.
distractorRationale.a: The table shows smaller positive differences elsewhere.
